_note: Occurrences window parsing/defaults/validation. Sources: app/views/scheduler/occurrences.py:54-103; utils/iso_datetime.py:19-59. Method: direct parse_iso_utc/coerce_iso_datetimes calls under pi_dash.settings.test; error bodies verified against contract test_invalid_window/test_window_too_large.

cases.note: aware datetime INSTANCES are never converted to UTC - only strings go through parse_iso_utc; naive instances get UTC attached (wall time kept)

coerce_iso_datetimes.rule: strings via parse_iso_utc (None skipped with warning); datetime instances passed through (+UTC attach when naive); anything else skipped with warning (utils/iso_datetime.py:36-57)
coerce_iso_datetimes.used_by: occurrences_between rdates/exdates per binding (occurrences.py:139-140) and the R6 next-fire forwarding (bgtasks/scheduler.py:70-83)

defaults.rule: each bound defaults INDEPENDENTLY when its parse yields None (occurrences.py:86-89): garbage from + valid to keeps the valid to

parse_iso_utc.rule: falsy -> None; value.replace('Z', '+00:00') then fromisoformat (ValueError -> None); naive -> UTC attached; aware -> astimezone(UTC) (utils/iso_datetime.py:19-33). QUIRK: replace() hits EVERY 'Z', not just a suffix.

validation.note: lowercase 'detail' alongside 'error': these are explicit Response dicts (contrast DRF-exception bodies in F36-09 which carry a lone 'detail' key, and gate denials which carry a lone 'error' key)
